sloka: केचित्तेजस्विनः शूराः क्षत्ऺित्रया युद्धदुर्मदाः ।तच्छासनमकुर्वन्तो विनेशुः सपरिच्छदाः ।। ७.१६.४९ ॥
transliteration: kecittejasvinaḥ śūrāḥ kṣatऺitrayā yuddhadurmadāḥ ।tacchāsanamakurvanto vineśuḥ saparicchadāḥ ।। 7.16.49 ॥

translations.english: Some powerful and brave Kshatriyas, unyielding in battle, who disobeyed his command, perished along with their retinue.
